2607.25634.title: AIriskEval-edu Demo: Auditing of Pedagogical Risks in Educational Explanations
2607.25634.paper_summary: We present AIriskEval-edu Demo, a platform that audits the pedagogical quality of instructional explanations and provides explainable audit results. The platform evaluates an explanation against a rubric covering five dimensions of pedagogical risk: factual accuracy, depth and completeness, focus and relevance, student-level appropriateness, and ideological bias. For each dimension, it returns a binary decision and a confidence score. Detected risks also include a natural-language rationale and, except for Depth and Completeness, a localized evidence span. The platform integrates GPT-5.5 through an external API and a self-hosted Llama 3.1 8B evaluator that runs on consumer-grade GPUs. The local evaluator is fine-tuned on AIriskEval-edu, a dataset of K-12 instructional explanations with risk and explainability annotations. The platform operates in two modes: in AI mode, both evaluators assess stored explanations generated under six simulated teacher profiles, each representing a distinct pedagogical behavior and potential risk; in human mode, the local evaluator audits user-written explanations in real time. The local evaluator outperforms GPT-5.5 on most reported metrics, offering educational institutions a practical way to keep audited content within their own infrastructure.
2607.25634.paper_summary_zh: 我們呈現 AIriskEval-edu Demo，一個審核教學解釋的教學品質的平台，並提供可解釋的審核結果。該平台根據涵蓋五個教學風險維度的標準來評估解釋：事實準確性、深度和完整性、焦點和相關性、學生層級的適當性，以及意識形態偏見。對於每個維度，它返回二元決策和信心分數。檢測到的風險還包括自然語言的理由，除了深度和完整性外，還有本地化的證據範圍。該平台通過外部 API 整合 GPT-5.5，以及一個自我托管的 Llama 3.1 8B 評估器，該評估器運行在消費級 GPU 上。當地評估器經過針對 AIriskEval-edu 的微調，這是一個包含風險和可解釋性註釋的 K-12 教學解釋數據集。該平台以兩種模式運行：在 AI 模式下，兩個評估器評估在六個模擬教師檔案下生成的存儲解釋，每個檔案代表一種獨特的教學行為和潛在風險；在人工模式下，當地評估器實時審核用戶撰寫的解釋。當地評估器在大多數報告的指標上超越 GPT-5.5，為教育機構提供了一種實用的方法，以在其自身基礎設施內保持經過審核的內容。
